reviewed_by: Claude Sonnet blind reviewer, batch B1 (g1 dp/mg + na_q1), 2026-08-12

samples_reviewed.question_text: Make a picture graph to show: cats: 1, dogs: 5, birds: 4, fish: 4. Draw one 🍎 for each item.
Make a picture graph to show: apples: 5, bananas: 3, mangoes: 8, grapes: 6. Draw one 🍎 for each item.
Make a picture graph to show: roses: 9, sunflowers: 9, tulips: 2, daisies: 3. Draw one 🍎 for each item.
Make a picture graph to show: Monday: 7, Tuesday: 8, Wednesday: 5, Thursday: 2. Draw one 🍎 for each item.
Make a picture graph to show: cats: 7, dogs: 1, birds: 10, fish: 10. Draw one 🍎 for each item.
Make a picture graph to show: Grade 1: 9, Grade 2: 10, Grade 3: 8, Grade 4: 5, Grade 5: 7, Grade 6: 4. Draw one 🍎 for each item.
Make a picture graph to show: Monday: 6, Tuesday: 4, Wednesday: 6, Thursday: 6, Friday: 9, Saturday: 6. Draw one 🍎 for each item.
Make a picture graph to show: basketball: 3, volleyball: 6, swimming: 3, running: 7, soccer: 1, tennis: 7. Draw one 🍎 for each item.
Make a picture graph to show: Monday: 6, Tuesday: 8, Wednesday: 3, Thursday: 10. Draw one 🍎 for each item.
Make a picture graph to show: Math: 10, Science: 9, English: 1, Art: 2. Draw one 🍎 for each item.

competency_fulfillment.rationale: Each item correctly instructs the student to build a graph from given counts, but the fixed closing line "Draw one 🍎 for each item" hands out an apple icon even for categories like dogs or Monday, breaking the pictorial correspondence a pictograph is supposed to teach.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: The category sets sampled range from four groups (cats, dogs, birds, fish) up to six (the six weekdays, the six grade levels), giving a reasonable spread of one-variable datasets to present.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: Counts requested for drawing stay in the 1-10 range and the instruction is a single short sentence, both suited to Grade 1 Quarter 3.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: All ten sampled seeds end on the identical instruction "Draw one 🍎 for each item" with no alternative phrasing or icon choice to distinguish one presentation task from the next.

competency_alignment.rationale: What actually changes seed to seed is the dataset itself -- the labels and their counts -- which is exactly the axis this presenting-data competency is meant to exercise.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: Values to be drawn top out at 10, consistent with an unscaled Grade 1 pictograph where each icon equals one unit.
